name: Yunik Managing Advisors Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Yunik Managing Advisors Ltd is in the business of rendering consultancy and advisory services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
YMAL is primarily engaged in the business of providing strategic advisory services and business start-up consultancy services. 
The company offers a wide range of 
investment and brokerage services.

cons: Stock is trading at 33.3 times its book value
